scientific_integrity: Proved covariance representations and sharp asymptotics for every fixed full-dimensional base; exact checker independently tests several bases. No independence or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Coordinate-Euclidean conditioning, not affine-invariant conditioning; the base must remain fixed as the number of factors increases; a generic earlier equivalent statement remains possible.
title: Exponential versus quadratic covariance conditioning in pyramids over repeated polytope products
